what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bosnia and Herzegovina in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 282 asylum seekers from Bosnia and Herzegovina in Italy, 39.6% of all asylum seekers from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina, a separate group, live mostly in Serbia and Kosovo, France, Denmark and Switzerland.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Bosnia and Herzegovina in these years, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2010, 2012 and 2024 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 288 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2011.
The figure was at its highest, 302, at the end of 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
